title: Future Jobs
subtitle: Dream big. Plan your next chapter.
description: Career choices, future plans, job interviews and the first steps towards your dream job.

activities.title: A phone conversation
answers: HR: Good morning. How can I help you?
Candidate: I’m Deniz Kaya. I applied for the web designer position. Could we schedule an interview?
HR: Certainly. Are you available on Tuesday at 10?
Candidate: I’m sorry, I have a class then. Could we meet at 2?
HR: Yes, that’s fine. See you on Tuesday at 2.
Candidate: Thank you. Have a nice day.
activities.prompt: Role-play a phone call between an HR manager and a candidate to schedule a job interview.

activities.title: Swap roles: another short model
answers: Candidate: Hello, I’m Ece Yılmaz. I’m calling about the engineer position.
HR: Can you come on Wednesday at 11?
Candidate: Yes, that’s fine by me. Thank you.
HR: You’re welcome. See you then.
activities.prompt: Change roles and role-play the phone conversation again.

activities.label: Video Blog 1
activities.title: Are video blogs useful in English?

activities.label: Video Blog 2
activities.title: A brief job interview script
answers: Manager: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Candidate: I’m a recent engineering graduate. I enjoy designing and solving problems.
Candidate: I’m organised, hardworking and a good team player.
Manager: Why do you want this job?
Candidate: I want to use my skills and learn from your team.
activities.note: Record with your partner, then assess fluency and accuracy after watching. Evaluation depends on the actual performance.
activities.prompt: Imagine one of you is an HR manager and the other is a job candidate. Write and record a short interview together.
